subject: Pseudobornia articulated scaffold with laciniate leaf whorls
factual_scope: Pseudobornia ursina interpretation informed by Rastier2025 primary reappraisal, vegetative description p12-13 and Fig3, fertile interpretation Fig15 also inspected. Primary fossils mostly detached; exact complete outline remains uncertain. Two-metre artistic juvenile whole-habit form rather than claim of mature fossil size. Nominal8cm leaves are source-informed illustrative target, not hard tolerance.
identifying_features: One continuous articulated main stem, six obliquely ascending second-order branches distributed over four nodes with only one or two branches per main-stem node. No radial conifer-like primary whorls.

Twelve third-order branches each continue to a short fourth-order terminal twig; two nodes on each terminal twig carry four erect laciniate leaves,96 leaves total. Leaves absent from trunk and large branches.

Each leaf is a coherent deeply dissected feather-like lamina with narrow divisions and central division, not an undivided ginkgo/palm fan or free horsetail needles. Sterile plant: reproductive structures intentionally absent, not obsolete cones.

scale.accuracy: Nominal artistic targets only, not exact hard equalities or fossil measurements. No invented micrometre-scale geometric gate.
